label: Размер
description: A 10-sentence usage card for размер (size; amount).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Размер' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'подходит'. 'Этот' points at a specific size, and 'мне' is the dative experiencer.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Размер' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'знаю', identical to the nominative. 'Обуви' is a genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Размера' is the genitive after 'нет', marking what is missing. 'Нужного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Размера' is the genitive after 'от', the factor on which the price depends. 'Квартиры' is a further genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Размеру' is the dative required by 'соответствует', the standard matched. 'Скидки' is a genitive modifier naming the discount.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О размере' uses the prepositional form 'размере' after 'о' to mark the topic of discussion.
Strategic focus: Dative of respect. 'По размеру' uses the dative 'размеру' after 'по' to specify in what respect the box is small.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'по'. 'По размеру' uses the dative to mean made to measure. 'Точно' reinforces the precise fit.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Размеры' is the nominative plural in the existence frame 'есть'. 'Все' agrees with it, and 'в магазине' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Размеры' is the inanimate accusative plural object of 'измерили', matching the nominative plural. 'Комнаты' is a genitive modifier.
